title: Not a high-quality product - Screws popped up the desk surface
text: Not a high-quality product - Screws popped up the desk surface. The shipping was good but the product did not meet the expectation. Followed the manual for the product assembly but the screws popped up the desk surface even with gentle torque. It is not a high-quality product. Do not want to go through the hassle of sending it back. I wrote to the seller but never heard back.
